India wins T20 series against Zimbabwe

The Indian cricket team defeated Zimbabwe by 90 runs in the second T20 match to win the series. This victory marked India's first T20 series win under captaincy of Shreyas Iyer. The team's focus is on developing young player Vaibhav Suryavanshi's batting, with his bowling development to be approached cautiously. Notably, eight key Indian players, including Jasprit Bumrah, will miss the upcoming ODI series due to scheduling conflicts with the Asian Games 2026.
